meta.name: talking-head-recut
meta.description: Package an existing talking-head / interview / podcast video with timed, designed GRAPHIC OVERLAY cards — kinetic titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, picture-in-picture — synced to the transcript, on a 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5 canvas of your choice; the clip plays untouched underneath. Trigger on "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics", "package / dress up my video". Not plain subtitles (/embedded-captions). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把口播或访谈视频加上随字幕同步的图形卡片,原片画面保持不动
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手里有口播或访谈素材,想加同步图形卡但不想动原画面。
copy.tagline_en: Add transcript-synced graphic cards to your talking-head video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have talking-head footage and want graphic cards fast

howto.what: 给已有的口播、访谈或播客视频叠加按时序设计的图文卡片,如标题、下三分之一、数据标注、引用等,卡片与转录文字的时间对齐,底层视频原样播放,可选 16:9、9:16、4:5 画布并渲染成 MP4。
howto.when: 当你提到「graphic overlays」「on-screen graphics」等关键词,或要求给视频做画面包装时触发。不做普通字幕(那是 /embedded-captions),意图不清先走 /hyperframes。

say.text: 帮我把这段访谈视频加上图文卡片,做成 9:16
say.note: 先本地转录,再设计卡片

say.text: 给这条播客视频做画面包装,用 16:9
say.note: 视频原样播放,卡片按时序叠加

say.text: 这段口播太素了,帮我加标题和数据标注卡片
say.note: 卡片时间对齐转录词级时间戳

howto.what_en: It layers timed, designed graphic cards (titles, lower-thirds, callouts, quotes, pip) onto an existing talking-head, interview or podcast video, synced to the transcript, on a 16:9, 9:16 or 4:5 canvas; the clip plays untouched underneath.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "graphic overlays" or "on-screen graphics", or ask to package/dress up a video. Not for plain subtitles (/embedded-captions); unclear intent goes to /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Add graphic cards to this interview video and make it 9:16
say_en.note: Transcribes locally first, then designs the cards

say_en.text: Package this podcast video with on-screen graphics in 16:9
say_en.note: Video keeps playing, cards overlay on top

say_en.text: Dress up this talking-head clip with titles and data callouts
say_en.note: Card timing follows the transcript words
